name: VR Fire Response
summary: VR Fire Response is a cutting-edge, immersive training simulation designed to educate users on the effective deployment of fire extinguishers in  an emergency situation. This interactive virtual reality application replicates a fire scenario, providing guidance on  operating a fire extinguisher in accordance with established safety protocols. This is not a substitute for real fire extinguisher training and does not cover all types of fire extinguishers or fires.
